questions.question: God called Assyria the rod of His anger. What did He call the staff in Assyria's hands?
God sent Assyria against a godless nation, but what did Assyria's king have in his own heart to do?

answers.text: Destroy and cut off many nations
Bring the people back to God

questions.question: The king of Assyria gave the LORD the credit for all his victories. True or false?
God said a fire would destroy the forests of Assyria. How many trees would be left afterward?

answers.text: So few a child could count them
Just enough to build one house
One left standing on each hill
